davmail_listen.description: Enable or disable the DavMail server. Set to 'false' to stop the server without uninstalling.

davmail_port.description: IMAP default port (used if no specific IMAP port is configured).

davmail_ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for the main port. Requires keystore configuration.

davmail_keystore.description: Path to Java keystore file containing the server certificate and private key.

davmail_keyPassword.description: Password for the private key inside the keystore (if different from keystore password).

davmail_truststore.description: Path to Java truststore containing trusted CA certificates (for validating Exchange server certificate).

davmail_protocol.description: Protocol to use for connecting to Exchange: 'auto', 'owa', 'ews', or 'exchange2007_sp1_ews'.

davmail_host.description: Hostname or IP address of your Exchange server.

davmail_port_exchange.description: Port on which Exchange listens for the selected protocol (usually 443 for HTTPS).

davmail_path_exchange.description: URL path to the Exchange web service endpoint (varies by Exchange version).

davmail_authentication.description: Authentication method: 'basic' (HTTP Basic Auth) or 'ntlm' (NTLMv2 for Windows domain).

davmail_username.description: Exchange username (if not using per-user credentials in mailboxes section).

davmail_ntlmDomain.description: Windows domain name, required when using NTLM authentication.

davmail_ntlmHost.description: Host (NetBIOS) name of the client workstation, required by some NTLM setups.

davmail_connectionTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds before giving up on establishing a connection to Exchange.

davmail_socketTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for socket read operations.

davmail_maxConnections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections to Exchange.

davmail_logFile.description: Full path to the log file.

davmail_proxy_host.description: Optional HTTP proxy host (e.g., for outbound connections in corporate networks).

davmail_imapPort.description: Port for IMAP service (default: 1143). Set to 0 to disable IMAP.

davmail_imapIdle.description: Enable IMAP IDLE support for real-time push notifications (requires client support).

davmail_popPort.description: Port for POP3 service (default: 1110). Set to 0 to disable POP3.

davmail_popDeletePolicy.description: When to delete messages from Exchange after POP retrieval: 'never', 'onRead', 'onTrash', or 'afterDays:N'.

davmail_popMaxMessages.description: Maximum number of messages per POP session.

davmail_smtpPort.description: Port for SMTP service (default: 1025). Set to 0 to disable SMTP.

davmail_smtpAuth.description: Require authentication for sending mail via SMTP (recommended).

davmail_smtpRequireAuth.description: If true, reject unauthenticated SMTP attempts (even if smtpAuth=false).

davmail_smtpStarttls.description: Enable STARTTLS for SMTP (upgrade to TLS after connection).

davmail_smtpUseSSL.description: Enable SSL for SMTP (connect over SSL from the start).

davmail_smtpAllowLocalFrom.description: Allow 'From:' headers to use local-domain addresses (e.g., @localhost).

davmail_web_enabled.description: Enable built-in web UI for diagnostics and status (port 8080 by default).

davmail_webPort.description: Port for the web UI (used only if web_enabled=true).

davmail_allow_untrusted_certificates.description: Allow connections to Exchange servers using self-signed or untrusted certificates (security risk).

davmail_serverId.description: Unique identifier for the DavMail server (used by Outlook to distinguish multiple gateways).

davmail_mailboxes.description: List of mailbox configurations with custom folder paths per user or profile.

name.description: Mailbox identifier (e.g., email address or alias). Use 'default' for global settings.

folderPrefix.description: Optional prefix for folder paths (e.g., 'Mailbox - ' for shared mailboxes).

folderInbox.description: Localized name of the Inbox folder.

folderSent.description: Localized name of the Sent folder.

folderDrafts.description: Localized name of the Drafts folder.

folderTrash.description: Localized name of the Deleted Items folder.

folderJunk.description: Localized name of the Junk Email folder.

folderArchive.description: Localized name of the Archive folder (if used).
